title: zh-CN leftovers from the 2026-09-28 cloud E2E: action success toast, env login SSO button and divider, Build Doctor, marketplace breadcrumb and placeholder
body:
## Source

Same two 2026-09-28 end-to-end runs as its sibling cards, with the browser in zh-CN. These are the objectui-owned strings from objectstack-ai/cloud#2435; the cloud-owned strings stay on that card. Epic: objectstack-ai/cloud#2440.

## Strings shown in English under zh-CN

| where | text |
|---|---|
| generic action success toast, e.g. after a cloud welcome CTA | `Action completed successfully` |
| environment login page | `Continue with ObjectStack` · `OR CONTINUE WITH EMAIL` |
| build conversation header button | `Build Doctor` |
| environment Setup → marketplace breadcrumb / search placeholder | `Marketplace` · 「按名称或 manifest ID 搜索」 (`manifest ID` is jargon for customers) |

## Acceptance

Under zh-CN each surface above renders Chinese. The English source stays the default.
